Before you decide

Use these questions when comparing vehicles or talking with a retailer.

  • Confirm Canadian specifications and delivery timing with BMW.
  • Check charging options at home and on your regular routes.
  • Ask for current range, warranty and equipment information for your trim.

Canada & U.S. context: This video uses the market named in its title. Canadian equipment, prices and availability may differ from U.S. offerings. This companion page does not publish a current price quote.
